phases.label: The work
phases.title: The answer was only part of the work.
phases.text: Behind it: a reference recovered, a comparison made, a check worth keeping.

phases.label: The return
phases.title: A new run. A familiar question.
phases.text: The evidence changed. The reasoning kept returning.

phases.label: The method
phases.title: Good reasoning should outlive the task.
phases.text: Keep the sequence. Keep the checks. Give the next investigation a better starting point.

phases.label: The build
phases.title: I built a way to keep it working.
phases.text: A method became software. Real use revealed what to build next.

phases.label: ARTIFACTS
phases.title: One need at a time. A system took shape.
phases.text: Sixteen distinct applications, each built around work that deserved a better way.
